name: Sale To POI Protocol Parameter 4
definition: Configuration parameters to communicate with a sale system.

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Type of action for the configuration parameters.

ProtocolVersion.name: Protocol Version
ProtocolVersion.definition: Uniquely identifies the protocol version to use when using these parameters.

MerchantPOIIdentification.name: Merchant POI Identification
MerchantPOIIdentification.definition: Identification of the POI during communication with sale system.

SaleIdentification.name: Sale Identification
SaleIdentification.definition: Identification of the SaleSystem connected to the POI.

AllowedSaleMessage.name: Allowed Sale Message
AllowedSaleMessage.definition: Identify a message that a Sale system could send to the POI system.

AllowedPOIMessage.name: Allowed POI Message
AllowedPOIMessage.definition: Identify a message that a POI system could send to the Sale system.

AllowedPOIService.name: Allowed POI Service
AllowedPOIService.definition: Identify a service that a POI system could support to the Sale system.

AllowedSaleDevice.name: Allowed Sale Device
AllowedSaleDevice.definition: Identify a device request that a Sale system could ask to the POI system.

ExternallyTypeSupported.name: Externally Type Supported
ExternallyTypeSupported.definition: List of types that the receiver supports and that the sender could use as type of an ExternallyDefinedData message component.
